security_recall_007.evidence: Entitlement re-employment shall remain in effect for eighteen (18) months. / Surplus teachers shall have the right to return to their original school... return can be accomplished within two (2) years of the original transfer / Teachers who are re-employed for the following school year shall suffer no interruption of health or term life coverage provided they complete the re-training

security_rif_criterion_008.answer: Certification; Contractual Status; Part-Time Employment; Training, Experience and Individual Qualifications; Seniority
security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: The following criteria are to be applied in order of priority as listed: a. Certification: Appropriate certification... b. Contractual Status... c. Part-Time Employment... d. Training, Experience and Individual Qualifications e. Seniority

security_probation_length_009.evidence: New teachers shall hold a Provisional License, successfully complete the Entry-Year Program and performance assessment within two years, and obtain a five year Professional License.

security_tenure_rules_010.evidence: Each teacher who has attained the career level in the TES of the Cincinnati Public Schools upon re-employment shall be offered a continuing contract, provided that teacher holds a valid eight-year Professional Ohio Teaching Certificate or five year professional license.

security_certification_011.evidence: New teachers shall hold a Provisional License, successfully complete the Entry-Year Program and performance assessment within two years, and obtain a five year Professional License. Teachers who have a certificate on file in the Human Resources Office, which needs to be renewed, shall be informed by the administration of the necessity to renew in January of the year of renewal.
